prompt:
You are an expert video director and technical judge reviewing an animated explainer video.
Watch and inspect the complete local video file at: video.mp4 with audio. Base your evaluation strictly on what you visually see and hear in the video; do not look for, open, or read any other files or source code. DO NOT write or run scripts. DO NOT extract frames. ONLY watch the video and return the required JSON. Evaluate it decisively against the following 12 quality criteria:

1. [HARD GATE] One persistent stage (key: "persistent_stage"):
   Requirement: One unified visual stage. Elements persist across beat boundaries rather than being wiped clean. Stage-clears must be <= 1 per 30s. No jump cuts between disconnected static layouts.
   Pass Target: Stage-clears <= 1 per 30s; layout continuity maintained across beats

2. [CRITERION] Carry-over with transformation (key: "carry_over_transformation"):
   Requirement: Elements carry over between beats and visibly change position, scale, shape, or role (e.g. points tilt into 3D layers, query drops layer to layer, graph slides and transforms into a pipeline card).
   Pass Target: At least 1 transforming carry-over event per 17s

3. [CRITERION] Visible cause and effect (key: "visible_cause_effect"):
   Requirement: Every narrated mechanism or action verb is paired with an animation starting within 0.4s of the spoken keyword that visibly moves or transforms the named object. A character performance may begin its anticipation earlier; its decisive moment (for a catch, the hand meeting the object) must land on the spoken keyword and its result must stay visible afterwards.
   Pass Target: Animations directly depict the spoken action keywords in real time

4. [HARD GATE] Camera that does something (key: "camera_purpose"):
   Requirement: Purposeful camera movement (pan, zoom, tilt, payoff pull-back) with at least 1 move per 17s. Every move must change what is framed; no aimless drift or frantically fast pans (>20% width/sec).
   Pass Target: Purposeful framing changes >= 1 per 17s; smooth cinematic motion

5. [HARD GATE] Captions at placed position (default bottom) (key: "bottom_captions"):
   Requirement: Burned-in captions located at the owner-declared card position (default: bottom 20-22% of the frame) for >= 95% of narrated time. Clean typography (>= 36px at 1080p), max 2 lines, no widows, exactly matching spoken voiceover words.
   Pass Target: Present at declared position (default bottom) for >= 95% of speech; words synchronized

6. [HARD GATE] Readability (key: "readability"):
   Requirement: All on-screen text is legible (body text >= 24px, labels >= 20px at 1080p), high contrast (>= 4.5:1), and dwells on screen for >= 0.35s per word. No microscopic or unreadable text.
   Pass Target: Zero unreadable text violations; contrast and dwell times met

7. [HARD GATE] No overlap or clipping (key: "no_overlap_clipping"):
   Requirement: Zero collisions between text blocks, zero text intersecting graphics, zero artwork clipped outside screen bounds, and all critical content respects safe margins (>= 96px at 1080p).
   Pass Target: Zero text-text or text-art collisions; zero edge clippings

8. [HARD GATE] Audio sync (key: "audio_sync"):
   Requirement: Visual cues land within 120ms of spoken words. Shot transitions occur during natural speech pauses. The story (everything before the fixed end card) matches the voiceover audio duration within 100ms.
   Pass Target: Cues aligned within 120ms; voiceover and video durations match

9. [CRITERION] Pacing (key: "pacing"):
   Requirement: Dynamic visual rhythm at the brisk house pace: no static frame held unchanged for > 2.5s in the story (the end card's held, dimmed final stage is intentional), mean beat length at most 10s (shorter is fine), no dead air > 0.6s, narration delivery pace 155-205 words per minute, every word still clearly intelligible.
   Pass Target: Continuous visual motion; no static freezes > 2.5s; brisk but clear delivery

10. [CRITERION] Storyline (key: "storyline"):
   Requirement: Clear narrative arc: problem statement introduced upfront, each beat logically builds upon the previous one without disjointed leaps, the story concluding with an integrated payoff scene (the fixed like-and-subscribe end card after it is not the payoff).
   Pass Target: Logical build; beats cannot be arbitrarily reordered; clear payoff

11. [CRITERION] Accuracy and honesty (key: "accuracy_honesty"):
   Requirement: Every number, metric, and label shown on screen is spoken in the narration or clearly marked illustrative. Diagrams accurately portray the actual computational mechanism.
   Pass Target: Zero ungrounded numbers or misleading visual claims

12. [CRITERION] Loudness and mix (key: "audio_mix"):
   Requirement: Clean, professional audio mix: integrated loudness -14 to -18 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBFS, zero audio clipping, background music ducked >= 12dB under voice, voice is crisp.
   Pass Target: -14 to -18 LUFS; zero clipping; voiceover clearly intelligible

SCORING AND VERDICT RULES:
1. Provide an overall score out of 10.0 (decimals allowed, e.g. 7.5, 9.2).
2. For EACH of the 12 criteria, provide:
   - "name": the exact criterion key (e.g. "persistent_stage")
   - "title": human-readable title
   - "isGate": boolean (true for the 6 hard gates: persistent_stage, camera_purpose, bottom_captions, readability, no_overlap_clipping, audio_sync)
   - "score": score from 0.0 to 10.0
   - "passed": boolean (true if meets the pass target, false if defective)
   - "evidenceTimestamps": array of timestamps (e.g. ["0:04", "0:25-0:31"]) citing exactly where in the video you observed this behavior. YOU MUST PROVIDE REAL TIMESTAMPS FOR EVERY CRITERION.
   - "reason": concise explanation citing what occurs at those timestamps.
3. Verdict rule:
   - If overallScore >= 9.0 AND all 6 hard gates passed (isGate=true criteria have passed=true and score >= 6.0), the verdict is "ACCEPT".
   - Otherwise, the verdict is "REVISE". Be strict, objective, and decisive.
4. Provide prioritized, constructive, and concrete feedback in "feedback":
   - For each issue, specify priority ("high", "medium", "low"), approximate timestamp, the specific issue observed, and the concrete recommended action for the AI animator/agent.
LOOK PLAN CHECK (unscored): If the deterministic facts include a LOOK PLAN SHOTS strip, compare each listed shot's planned treatment, carried objects, and cue with what you see. Ask: "For each listed shot, does the video show what the plan says carries the beat? Cite timestamps for every mismatch." Put each observed mismatch in feedback with a timestamp. Do not add a criterion or change any of the 12 criterion scores or the verdict based on the plan.

Return ONLY valid JSON matching this schema:
{
  "overallScore": number,
  "verdict": "ACCEPT" | "REVISE",
  "summary": string,
  "criteria": [
    {
      "name": string,
      "title": string,
      "isGate": boolean,
      "score": number,
      "passed": boolean,
      "evidenceTimestamps": string[],
      "reason": string
    }
  ],
  "feedback": [
    {
      "priority": "high" | "medium" | "low",
      "timestamp": string,
      "issue": string,
      "recommendation": string
    }
  ]
}
